notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hey guys!

It's been a long time since any updates.

I tweaked the level design in some places, particularly those hard 'overhang ledge' jumps(level 6 and others) that only few people seemed to be able to do. I removed them completely and changed them with a different kind of jump, hopefully that helps make the game less frustrating for some of you who really didn't like that jump.

Also added a couple more level variations for the first few levels.

And made a few small visual tweaks. 

I decided to not reset the game leaderboards, as the tweaks aren't so big that they would change leaderboard times considerably. 

Anyway, hope you like this little update!

Thanks,
Nauris

notes.title: Small hotfix update!
notes.content:
Hey!

Just set a small hotfix live with a few fixes -

The level 6 cliff jump has been made a little easier.
You now keep running if the button is held and move to next level.
Small tweaks in other levels.
Made text in highscore tables smaller, so names dont go out of bounds.
And some other small tweaks.
